abstract: Locally maintained React and Next.js performance guidance with 70 rules across 8 categories. Examples and impact labels guide investigation, not automatic migrations or guaranteed speedups. Preserve behavior and existing architecture, check prerequisites, and verify meaningful changes on the target workload.

upstream.original_import_revision_note: The original imported revision was not recorded; the checked reference below is not asserted to be that revision.
upstream.review_scope: Pinned documentation comparison and targeted API/correctness review; not a complete upstream refresh.

divergence: Portable local discovery and reference routing.
Version, correctness, permission, and repository-convention guards; locally corrected examples.
Deterministic compiled reference with source digest; impact labels are workload-dependent heuristics.
